profile_text.body:
Notion Labs is a for-profit startup founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company makes Notion, a workspace tool, and describes its AI layer as a built-in teammate that works directly inside pages, documents, tasks, and databases. The site positions Notion AI as an all-in-one feature set covering search, generation, analysis, and chat without requiring users to switch between applications.

Notion AI's tracked products include Notion AI, embedded across the workspace, and Notion Q&A, which answers questions drawn from a workspace corpus while being described as permission-aware. Additional features called out on the site include AI Meeting Notes for transcription and summarization, Enterprise Search with connectors to external tools such as Slack and Google Drive, and Custom Agents that can run on schedules or triggers to handle multi-step tasks autonomously. Notion AI is included with Business and Enterprise plans; Custom Agents run on a credit system priced as an add-on at $10 per 1,000 credits. The site also states that Notion AI enables HIPAA compliance by using LLM providers' zero-retention APIs, and that customer data is not used to train models unless the user opts in, with contractual restrictions placed on AI subprocessors as well.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server entries for Notion Labs. The company has a profile page on theworldofai.org under uid 71dea4ed.
